measurement: The ComforTrac Cervical is a universal fit device. No circumference measurement is required. Neck wedges are manually adjusted by your clinician to 1 of 5 positions to fit the back of your head and neck. The slide stand adjusts to 10, 15, or 20 degrees of cervical flexion as directed by your clinician. Upper cervical region uses 10 degrees; Middle cervical region uses 15 degrees; Lower cervical region uses 20 degrees. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
